brief: How to build 5 content pillars that never run dry — the editorial approach.

slots.subtitle: Build an editorial engine that produces endless high-value content without creative burnout.

slots.body: Most creators burn out because they treat every post as a blank slate. The editorial approach treats content like a publication — predictable, repeatable, and scalable.
Build pillars around the 10-15 questions your audience asks on repeat. Interview customers, read comments, and mine Reddit. Their curiosity becomes your content calendar.
Turn your workflow into content. Share how you write, design, decide, or ship. Process content is endlessly renewable because your work never stops evolving.
You do not need original research every day. Collect bold opinions, add your contrarian angle, and become the filter your audience trusts to make sense of the noise.
Your best post from six months ago is new to someone today. Slice carousels into threads. Expand tweets into articles. One strong idea can fuel ten formats.
Trends expire in days. Principles last for years. Write about mental models, timeless frameworks, and universal truths that stay relevant no matter the algorithm.
Build your five pillars this week. Your future content calendar will thank you.
